note: GROUNDWORK PLATFORM DEFAULT — the seed values every brand-new tenant's tenant_finance_policy row starts from, not any one customer's actual policy. materiality_threshold_cents defaults from approval-thresholds.json's default_materiality_threshold_cents at seed time — duplicated here as an explicit override point per tenant type, not a second source of truth (tenant-onboarding code should prefer approval-thresholds.json unless a tenant type below is selected).
